findings.finding: --require-committed compares generated MODULE.bazel.lock with entry working-tree bytes but never establishes that entry bytes or other tracked source equal HEAD. index_tree is recorded without a HEAD equality gate.
findings.recommendation: Run and require git diff --exit-code HEAD -- before original check/update/check, and again before passed status; keep all command exits and generated lock bytes on failure, or compare original bytes with exact HEAD Git blob.
findings.resolution: Revised ea98d20 requires entry bytes equal git show HEAD:MODULE.bazel.lock, then git diff --exit-code HEAD -- before all original commands and after all gates. Failures raise before status=passed; checkout checks and both streams are recorded. Original check/update/check sequence and any-nonzero rejection are retained.
